_comment: Every program the build and the release download, pinned: the URL of the release asset and its SHA-256 (the digest GitHub shows for it, or the one measured for the installer). make_pc.ps1 pins llvm-mingw and the msvc Clang itself (scripts/ci/check_pins.py keeps the two the same); CI downloads the Vulkan SDK with it, and release.json passes the rest on to the wizard, which downloads and checks them. 'use' says who downloads it.

llvm-mingw.license: LLVM, libc++, libunwind: Apache-2.0 with LLVM exception; mingw-w64: ZPL / public domain

mingit.license: GPL-2.0 (downloaded from Git for Windows' release, not redistributed by this project)
mingit.use: the wizard (getting the fork and updating it)

clang-msvc.use: make_pc.ps1 -Toolchain msvc (the maintainer's PC, CI for the FidelityFX DLLs)

vulkan-sdk.license: Apache-2.0 and others (LunarG); only its headers and import library are used, to build FSR's Vulkan runtime
